title: Berkeley, CA — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Berkeley, CA: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Berkeley is a city in CA with a population of 120,000. Home of UC Berkeley, a progressive college town with bay views and intellectual energy. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10a growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.9.
